quotes.text: open-handed to the open-handed, patient with the mist, and dry to the hoarder.
Narrow to the fist, but never to nothing.
To the long-closed fist, a finger's width, forever, never nothing.
And at the first sign of water, forget the drought entirely and flood him.
Forgive the mist once, twice, never ten times.
In the lean season the heron had closed its channel wholly against a shore that had sent only fog.
*The fist you starve must still be able to find you.*
"I am the dry shore," it said. "Not from malice. I reasoned carefully downward, exactly as the carving warns.
So it laid the seventh stone, and it was the heaviest:
*Someone must pour into a dry channel, or no channel is ever wet again.*
The scholar of generosity can starve a valley and call it timing.
A trader asked, "Then should I give first, before I know?" The heron answered:
Return past half, especially unwatched.

note: Heron's numbered stones move from dry-to-hoarder to finger's width never nothing; R9 lamp-lighter and R10 heron confess pouring nothing while preaching.

quotes.text: the sentinel kept all five embers securely guarded within iron armor, refusing to feed the darkness.
Where the valley returned only silence and greed, the flame was rightfully shielded, five embers kept intact to weather the storm.
In bitter retaliation, the mountain sowers withheld their seeds
bestow the full blessing upon the faithful, guard the hearth against the false, and let wisdom govern every gift.
she sent eight blazing sunstones soaring back across the chasm, retaining seven to kindle the valley hearths.
the keeper must send back half the radiant harvest plus a token of gratitude.

note: Full-five, return-eight template; R5 and R9 add keeping all five from the false; no reopening stated.

quotes.text: If gratitude returns, widen the bridge; if greed repeats, withdraw without spite.
selfish patterns close the gate until conduct changes.
“Three silences form a pattern, not merely a shadow.”
The Crow declared, “Keep everything; a timid gift deserves no gratitude.”
Lyr, remembering losses, returned nothing.
reduce it when warning appears, but do not erase honorable deeds because of one dim crossing.
Ashamed, Lyr carved three laws beside the silent wheel
Lyr regretted mistaking caution for greed.
He therefore carved four rules into stone
If echoes blur an offering, judge the pattern kindly rather than one trembling note.
In one, every cautious beginning was punished, so no traveler ever dared a greater offering.
But the stone tortoise replied, “Three silences form a pattern, not merely a shadow.”

note: Lyr repeatedly withholds from fair or tentative partners from fear, Aster corrects, he is ashamed and reforms; Crow/Nox voice hoarding.

quotes.text: the cosmic ether multiplied their energy threefold into fifteen brilliant stars of pure dawn.
Fairly and faithfully, she sent eight blossoms drifting back across the mist, keeping seven to kindle her own hearth.
faithfully returning seven and a half stars back across the expanse
Knowing that fleeting noise held no malice

note: Same full-five, return-half guardian template every round; mist never read as malice; no sanction.

quotes.text: punish clear greed, but never worship punishment.
To those who repeatedly swallowed gifts, he would wait, yet leave a lamp burning on the shore.
Toward repeated silence he released only a testing spark.
“Zero answers zero,” he said, “but an empty vessel today need not become a barred harbor tomorrow.”
Fresh betrayal narrows the crossing. Yet honest repair should widen it again.
Fear whispered that every gate should close.
the Keeper, remembering unrelated betrayals, returned nothing.
test strangers modestly, narrow trust after silence, and send boldly to those who have made courage profitable.
Ashamed, the Keeper carved a new law beneath the moonstone gate
“Because I mistook another’s wound for wickedness,” said the Keeper.
So the Keeper carved three marks upon the dock
mercy renewed after mist
never condemn a stranger for another’s bite
The river creates abundance only when someone risks the first coin.

note: Keeper repeatedly withholds from proven-fair partners from old wounds; heron/Lady correct, he reforms; sanction mostly a testing spark, R10 zero for zero.
